issues.message: The physical AI brakes when speed exceeds normal vmax despite earned pad/nitro/spray capacity. Same visible-input stage 01 baseline wins with 26 crashes, zero drift or nitro, 711.6 m ahead of nearest AI. This is observed agent performance, not human win rate.
After timeout, a second request reattaches to the documented singleton. A late close from the old video grants the new reward. Regression returns completed instead of unavailable.

An isEnded close emitted during load, or synchronously before show rejects, can currently grant ownership without a successful ad presentation. External SDK callbacks require presentation-phase validation, not trust based on payload alone.
